verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the llms.txt self-description of Tavily as offering "real-time web search." That glancingly supports the fresh-index part of the story but documents no filtering mechanism. Example queries like "latest AI news" are just query text, not recency or date controls. missing for 10: documented date-range parameters, recency/time-window filters, a news/topic freshness mode, index update-frequency details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of result freshness.
